original_target.title: The full set of zero-energy cubic-to-tetragonal strains

scope_comparison: Actual July2026 Ball–Galanopoulou Theorem18 characterizes positive diagonal matrices in the tetragonal hull. The Taylor-set upper bound and self-accommodation/interior-point results do not characterize arbitrary non-diagonal matrices. Introduction explicitly retains unknown full hull for at least three wells.
